<x0/>Previously it was written the other way around, and it was a mistake.<x1/> It said "filter on the intake,
      fan on the exhaust, then the pressure inside is lower and dust must pass through the filter". In reality,
      with reduced pressure, air is sucked in through <x2/>all<x3/> gaps bypassing the filter, and every
      leak becomes a dust entry point. The correct way is the opposite: blow filtered air inside,
      then any leak goes <x4/>outside<x5/> and dusty air doesn't enter against the gradient.
      This is the industrial standard for panels in dust — IEC 60079-2, mining guideline QGN34,
      BreatheSafe systems for Caterpillar cabins (aiming for 20-50 Pa excess). The cost:
      the fan must run continuously, which is 5-15 W, up to 2.5 kWh
      per week from our own battery.

<x0/>чому<x1/> · Питання Івана: раз до р: <x0/>why<x1/> · Ivan's question: since a twisted pair goes to the radar anyway, why not use it for the speaker from the brains in the podium floor to the head. Answer — no, and the reason is not in the cross-section, but in the shield. The Cat6 shield protects the radar line only while the interference source lies OUTSIDE the shield. Class D amplifier (TPA3116) outputs not sound, but a square wave about 300 kHz with current up to a couple of amps. Brought under the same shield, it ends up on the same side as the radar line, and the shield stops working altogether. Plus cross-section: Cat6 conductor is 23 AWG, on a 6-meter run to a 4 Ohm speaker this is 0.78 Ohm and 16% loss; 18 AWG gives 0.24 Ohm and 6%. Solution: radar — shielded twisted pair Cat6 (B09M5ZLYN4, already in the database), speaker — separate 18 AWG silicone cable, which has ALREADY arrived (B07FMRDP87), and a separate 2-pin connector. No extra cost for cable, $9.35 for connector.

<x0/>чому<x1/> · При вмиканні адресної с: <x0/>Why<x1/> · When turning on the WS2811 addressable strip, a short inrush current spike occurs: the power capacitors on the chips charge almost instantly, and if the cable between WLED and the strip is long or conductive, the spike can reflect back and reset the controller. <x0/>⚠ OUT − це НЕ земля. Підсилювач мос: <x0/>⚠ OUT − is NOT ground. Amplifier is bridged: both outputs "swing" relative to ground. Connecting OUT − to power minus, chassis, or minus of the second channel = short circuit and dead board. Speaker connects ONLY between OUT + and OUT −, nowhere else.<x1/>
<x0/>⚠ Не тримати одночасно USB і зовніш: <x0/>⚠ Do not hold USB and external 5V on VIN simultaneously — power from one source. Convenient on the bench: plug in USB, ESP32 and all modules are powered from it (draw about a quarter of an amp together, laptop draws); the amplifier still needs its own 12V. Before reflashing the node in assembled form — first remove 12V, then insert USB. In the mounting plan, USB faces the removable cover, so you can reflash without disassembling the node.<x1/>
<x0/>⚠ Підсилювачу 5 В не вистачить — йо: <x0/>⚠ 5V booster won't suffice — it needs its own 12V on "VCC + −", otherwise there will be no sound. And don't keep USB in ESP32 and external 5V on VIN simultaneously: power from one source only. Radar is powered by 5V, but communicates via UART at 3.3V — this is fine, ESP32 understands such levels directly.<x1/>
<x0/>💡 У платі є ДЖЕК 3.5 мм. Найшвидша: <x0/>💡 The board has a 3.5 mm JACK. Fastest sound check: plug headphones directly into the DAC and play a tone. If heard — DAC is alive, trace further along the path to the amplifier. Silence — issue in the DAC itself or its power.<x1/>

Measurement order: 1) Strip set to solid white 100% — I already set this mode, it's most sensitive to voltage drop. 2) Lower voltage on power supply in grid, wait 15 s at each point. 3) Record current at each point and note color: white / slightly warmer / yellow / orange. 4) Note voltage where white STOPPED being white to the eye — this is the working threshold. 5) Then run animation and go through points again: look for glitches — pixels out of place, flickering, frozen points. Chip powered from 4.5 V, so glitches start BELOW color threshold. 6) Raise voltage back to 12 V and check everything returns on its own, without restart.

ГОЛОВНЕ, чому саме дві пили, а не пробій: MAIN reason for two saws, not a punch: standard punch sizes follow conduit sizes — 1/2" gives 22.2 mm, next is 1-1/8" = 28.3 mm. Size 15/16" (23.8 mm) or 23 mm DOES NOT EXIST from any manufacturer: neither Klein, nor Ideal, nor Milwaukee, nor Southwire. And our light is not fixed: drawing asks for 22.0, purchased Sunmerit — 22.6. Punch at 22.2 for 22.6 is too small, and expanding a punched hole is physically impossible. Two hole saws for $15-25 cover BOTH options and remain useful for OSB. ⚠ In thin 1.6 mm sheet, a wooden backing underneath and center punching is mandatory, otherwise the saw grabs, leads the pilot sideways and bends the sheet. Burr after — with Noga deburrer. Link to 15/16" Makita; 7/8" — Lenox 1772429 or Milwaukee 49-56-9607, ~$10-15.

Крок між діодами 9.0 мм, зазор 12 мм — 1: Step between diodes 9.0 mm, gap 12 mm — 1.33 steps, i.e. "even light". Dot-diodes merge into even light when the distance from the board to the window is comparable to the step between diodes. With a gap of half a step, dots are still visible and only a thick opaque diffuser helps; with a gap of one step, the window glows evenly even with a thin one.

Крок рахувати «коло на кількість» тут не: The step to count "circle per quantity" cannot be used here: 241 diodes sit on nine nested circles. The real step is the distance between adjacent circles and between diodes of the outer ring: π×172/60 = 9.0 mm.

Потік біжить від зовнішнього кінця проме: The flow runs from the outer end of the beam to the center and WITHOUT INTERRUPTION goes by turn around the circle to the right — exactly to the base of the next beam. Beam and turn — this is one continuous strip, one sleeve. There is no separate ring: circle 2.14 m consists of eight turns of 0.2675 m, laid end to end. Sleeve = beam 0.95 + turn 0.2675 = 1.2175 m, eight sleeves = 9.74 m. Cut ONLY at the manufacturer's marks and ONLY at the ends of the sleeve — there is no cut inside the sleeve, otherwise the turn will cease to be a continuation of the beam. Round the length UP to the nearest mark, hide the excess down into the groove at the outer end of the beam, so the turn still reaches end to end with the neighbor.

Під 4 жовті світлодіоди, які Іван постав: For 4 yellow LEDs that Ivan installed on 13.08: two on the belt and two on the helmet above the eyes, right and left. Not in the chat, recorded from his words. ⚠ Yellow LED has Vf about 2.1 V, NOT 3 V — three volts is white and blue. If the resistor was calculated for 3 V, the actual current is higher than intended, and that's why it heats up. Calculation from the 12V bus: for 10 mA resistor 1 kOhm (dissipates 0.10 W), for 15 mA — 680 Ohm (0.15 W), for 20 mA — 510 Ohm (0.20 W). Recommendation: 10 mA, this is noticeably less heating and almost the same brightness for the indicator. Even better — two LEDs IN SERIES per pair (belt separately, helmet separately): then 750 Ohm for 10 mA, half the resistors and less heat in them. ⚠ Do NOT hang LEDs in parallel on one resistor: Vf spread leads to one taking the current on itself. Take 1/2 W, not 1/4: reserve for heat +40°C. Set BOJACK, 4.7★ at 855 reviews.
Під самостійний різ 8 сегментів алюмініє: For self-cutting 8 segments of aluminum floor from 1/16" sheet. Metalworker forums unanimous: for corrugated aluminum, use carbide blade, NOT abrasive (it clogs and can shatter). Cut with corrugated side DOWN, along guide rail, with WD-40 lubricant. Blade dulls after ~20 cuts. Specific model not yet chosen.
Під світлодіоди на корпусі фігури: за сл: For LEDs on the body of the figure: according to Ivan on 16.08 all yellow, four in the helmet above the eyes and two on the belt. USE 1 kOhm at 10 mA. Clarification 16.08: on the 12V bus the LED color almost doesn't matter — the resistor sees 9.9V vs 9.0V, current difference 9%, so 1 kOhm is safe for both yellow (9.9 mA) and white (9.0 mA). Previously there was a warning about Vf as critical — it's critical at 3-5V power, not at twelve. Each LED — its own resistor: can't hang in parallel on one, Vf spread leads to one taking the current. Use 1/2 W, not 1/4: reserve for heat +40°C. Set BOJACK, ★4.7 at 855 reviews. Radar gives distance to person via UART. Person at 3 m — full volume; approached closely at 1 m — quieter by ~8 dB (comfortable, not shouting in face). Formula: vol = base − 4·(3 − dist_m) dB, clamp 0…−10. This is impossible with PIR — another argument for radar decision.
Радар — на 5 В, НЕ на 3.3 В. LD2410C жив: Radar — at 5V, NOT at 3.3V. LD2410C powered from 5 to 24V; at 3.3V it either stays silent or gives false readings. UART logic is 3.3V — ESP32 understands it directly, but power needs to be 5V.
Радар: підійти на 3 м — тригер; постояти: Radar: approach at 3 m — trigger; stand aside at 5 m — silence; 30 s pause between phrases holds.

Сітчастий комп'ютерний фільтр тримає час: Mesh computer filter holds particles larger than <x0/>50 µm<x1/>, while playa dust is <x2/>1-10 µm<x3/>. But foam alone is not enough: foam and Outerwears-type covers from desert racing are <x4/>a coarse first stage<x5/>, catching sand and clumps and saving the second from quick clogging. Dust 1-10 µm is stopped only by a final filter of class <x6/>MERV 13<x7/> (85-90% at 1-3 µm) or higher. Standard mat of industrial fans Pfannenberg and Rittal is class G4, only 20-50% at 1-5 µm, not saving by itself. And the main thing about size: resistance grows as the square of speed on the filter, so a large 12×20 inch filter works almost without resistance at our flows and clogs slowly, while a 120 mm patch clogs in days.

У WS2811 на 12 В піксель — це три діоди: In WS2811 at 12 V, a pixel is three diodes in series plus a current-limiting resistor for each color. Red needs about 6 V for the trio, blue and green — up to 9.5 V. Therefore, their reserve is different: when the voltage drops, blue and green suffocate FIRST, and red holds the longest. White turns yellow, then orange. The WS2811 chip itself is powered from 4.5 V, so the animation runs long after the color has shifted — to the eye, everything "works," but white is no longer white.
У WS28xx кожен чіп їсть постійно, навіть: In WS28xx each chip consumes constantly, even when the diode is dark. Not noticeable on a meter, but accumulates on 9.77 m and enters the night budget.

ЦАП — це перекладач з цифри в звук. ESP3: DAC — a translator from digital to sound. ESP32 only understands numbers: it sends a stream of zeros and ones to the DAC via three wires (BCK — bit clock, LCK — frame clock, DIN — data itself). The speaker doesn't understand numbers, it needs voltage that swings smoothly. The DAC converts numbers into such voltage — weak, tenths of a volt. Then the amplifier takes this weak voltage and boosts it to power that moves the diaphragm. Without the DAC, there will be no conversation between ESP32 and the amplifier: one has nothing to listen to, the other has nothing to say.

ЦАПу трьох дротів мало: крім BCK, LCK, D: DAC needs more than three wires: besides BCK, LCK, DIN it requires VIN 5V and GND. Plus SCK to GND (otherwise silent) and XSMT to 3.3V (otherwise muted).
